Subject: HelixHealth: Request for SOC 2 & VPC operator evidence

Hi Jonas,

We're preparing our vendor security package for the upcoming risk review and need a compact evidence set from Redwood to satisfy our InfoSec team. Specifically we need:

- SOC 2 report summary (organization-level, latest year) + statement of which controls are in scope for inference hosting.
- SIG/CAIQ answers for regionally-hosted private deployments (we're evaluating VPC peering in us-west and us-east).
- A short operator roster for the VPC/private deployment (roles, on-call rotation window, and whether operators have keystore access).
- Keystore rotation policy and a sample rotation log (redacted) or link to audit logs showing a recent rotation.

Our review timeline is tight — can you confirm what you can provide by COB Monday (Nov 9)? Procurement has asked us to collect a minimal bundle so we can proceed to contract review.

Thanks,
Maria Ortega
Vendor Risk Lead, HelixHealth

1) SOC 2: summary PDF (covers scope: hosting + platform controls for hosted, dedicated, private). Will include our auditor cover letter and timestamps.
2) SIG/CAIQ: completed CAIQ export for the private deployment profile (with region-specific notes for US zones).
3) VPC operator roster: spreadsheet with operator role, rotation schedule, and whether each operator has any keystore privileges (we'll redact personal phone numbers).
4) Keystore rotation: policy excerpt + CSV sample rotation log (redacted) and pointer to audit log retention policy.

Attachments I'll send in a follow-up from the security mailbox (small PDF/XLS/CSV stubs). If you want the SOC 2 full report we can provide it under an NDA; the summary will be sufficient for initial review.

Cc'ing Hannah (security compliance) and Irene (ops/keystore) to add the artifacts and confirm the rotation sample. Ben, loop in sales-ops if Helix needs procurement paperwork tied to the bundle.

Hi Maria — passing along the operator/keystore artifacts you requested. A couple of operational notes first: 

- Operators: we run a 3-person on-call rotation for private deployment operators per region (Primary / Secondary / Tertiary). Access to customer keystores is strictly role-based and requires MFA + ticket approval for emergency access.
- Keystore rotation: we rotate operator credentials every 90 days and rotate customer KEKs (when we manage them) per customer SLA (default 180 days). We keep a redacted CSV of rotations for customer-facing attestations (no secrets in the file).

Attachments included: vpc-ops-roster.xlsx (XLSX) — columns: Role, Region, Oncall-window, Has-keystore-access (Yes/No), Last-training; keystore-rotation-schedule.csv (CSV) — sample redacted log.

I've also published a short runbook with steps for emergency key rotation and proof-of-rotation collection: https://app.redwood.dev/runbooks/vpc-operator-rotation (internal link; shared read-only view).

If Helix would like, we can provide a limited-scope SR (service review) where we walk through the operator roster and sample rotation log via a 30-minute session. Please let us know preferred time slots next week.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
